Point it at a meal, a food label, or a list of ingredients — and get a full breakdown of calories, protein, carbs, and fat in seconds. No manual logging. No barcode scanning. No approximating "homemade pasta" from a dropdown.

records.name: Rizz Report
records.tagline: Personalised AI report for your face, body & style
records.description: Stop guessing - start scanning. RizzReport turns a photo into a pro-grade personal analysis. Our Scanner Suite includes body scans, skin health, palm reading, wardrobe palettes, hairstyle guides and more. Every report is a viral-ready, high-res infographic built for IG/X. We are Privacy First (GDPR-aligned) and your photos are automatically deleted after analysis. Best of all? There are No Subscriptions - just pay-as-you-go credits. Join 900+ users and see what the AI sees in you!

records.name: Babelton
records.tagline: youtube music ai translator
records.description: Traduci canzoni da youtube istantaneamente con l'intelligenza artificiale.

records.name: ContractGuard AI
records.tagline: ContractGuard AI — AI contract review in 30 seconds
records.description: Every contract hides a knife. Find it in 30 seconds. ContractGuard AI reads your contract, highlights every risky clause, explains what it actually means, and suggests fairer wording — so you stop signing blind.

records.name: AVEncoder
records.tagline: Encode H.265 videos perfectly — zero manual tuning needed
records.description: Tired of tweaking CRF, presets, and psy-rd for the best H.265 encode? Adaptive Video Encoder does it for you. It analyzes your video frame by frame — detecting noise, grain, and complexity — then picks the optimal x265 parameters automatically. Drop your file in, get the smallest size with the best quality. Supports HDR10, Dolby Vision, HLG, resolutions up to 8K, and all major formats (MKV, MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM). Linux only. Open source on GitHub.

records.name: TEadifyz AI
records.tagline: Create & launch Meta and Google ads with AI
records.description: TEadifyz AI helps businesses create and launch Meta and Google ad campaigns in minutes using AI. Unlike traditional tools that require manual setup, users simply connect their ad accounts and enter their website to generate complete campaigns automatically. From ad copy to targeting and publishing, everything is handled in one place. This launch focuses on making advertising faster, simpler, and more accessible for businesses without relying on agencies.

records.name: Pixelcut
records.tagline: Pixelcut AI | Free Background Remover & Image Upscaler
records.description: Pixelcut AI is a 100% free online tool that instantly removes image backgrounds and upscales photos to 2K/4K resolution — no sign-up, no software, no watermarks. Powered by advanced AI, it delivers pixel-perfect cutouts and crystal-clear enlargements in seconds, directly in your browser.

records.name: thekiomoi
records.tagline: Get to Travel around India with Kiomoi Travels
records.description: Book Chandigarh to Manali tour package with 4 nights 5 days itinerary. Includes sightseeing, Solang Valley, Kullu & Manikaran. From Rs11,628.

records.name: ResumeAI
records.tagline: Free AI resume feedback with score and ATS keywords
records.description: ResumeAI scores your resume out of 10 and tells you exactly what to fix — strengths, improvements, missing ATS keywords, and a rewritten bullet point with metrics. No signup. No credit card. Free forever. Built with Python, Streamlit, and LLaMA 3.3. 🔗 resumeai-g4xqvccbqrtoyktb5ksivs.streamlit.app

records.name: Doudou: Baby Tracker for Two
records.tagline: Baby tracker for tired parents. Feeds, diapers, sleep. Done.
records.description: Baby tracker stripped to what actually matters: feedings, diapers, sleep. Three cards. One screen. One tap. Built by a sleep-deprived dad who couldn't remember the last feeding at 3 AM. Dark purple theme because bright screens wake babies. Family sync so both parents see the same data. One-handed use with large tap targets — because your other hand is holding a baby. Always.

records.name: Work-Streak
records.tagline: A Talent Intelligence Platform for Skill Visibility & Hiring
records.description: Most hiring today relies on self-declared resumes. We’re building Work-Streak - a Trusted Talent Intelligence Platform for Skill Visibility - external facing, Hiring (internal + external), and Verification. This helps reduce screening time and improve hiring quality.

records.name: CircuitLab
records.tagline: Resuelve circuitos DC paso a paso con IA y visualización 3D
records.description: CircuitLab resuelve circuitos DC, vectores, cinemática y campo magnético paso a paso. Muestra fórmulas, sustitución y resultado completo. Verifica leyes de Kirchhoff automáticamente. Incluye modo IA con Claude que explica cada concepto, visualización 3D interactiva de aparatos reales, modo Presentación para profesores, modo Live para aulas en tiempo real, exportar PDF y sincronización con Google Sheets vía n8n. Hecho por un estudiante de ingeniería, para estudiantes de ingeniería.

records.name: Full Moon Fairy
records.tagline: Secret Benefits of Reading Bedtime Stories for Kids
records.description: Discover the powerful benefits of bedtime stories for kids—boost imagination, emotional growth, and create a calming nightly routine your child will love.

records.name: Cyboruz
records.tagline: Scan your website for security SSL & email issues in seconds
records.description: Cyboruz scans your website for security, SSL, email and trust issues — then shows everything in one clear dashboard. Instead of using multiple tools, you can check SSL certificates, security headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, blacklist status and domain health in one place. Run a free scan in seconds and keep monitoring your website over time.

records.name: AnyCompare
records.tagline: AI agents that compare any products with clinical precision
records.description: Stop drowning in browser tabs and biased SEO affiliate lists. AnyCompare deploys parallel AI research agents to scrape, normalize, and verify technical specs across the web in real-time. Whether you're comparing SaaS providers, automotive specs, or developer tools, get an institutional-grade, zero-hallucination data matrix in seconds. Stop searching. Start deciding.

records.name: hvac
records.tagline: hvac service bellingham
records.description: Reliable HVAC in Bellingham MA including fast HVAC repair, installation, and maintenance. Keep your home comfortable year-round with expert local technicians.

records.name: HisabDo – Expense Tracker
records.tagline: Track expenses, manage budget & control spending easily
records.description: HisabDo is a simple and powerful expense tracker app that helps you manage daily spending and stay in control of your finances. Easily add expenses, track your budget, and monitor your spending habits with a clean and user-friendly interface. Built for everyday use, HisabDo makes money management fast, simple, and stress-free.

records.name: GitHub
records.tagline: Quality Audio Checker for lossy and lossless formats.
records.description: Detects fake high-quality audio files by identifying lossy-to-lossless transcodes using spectral analysis and half-or-strict-majority wall vote. - alessandrocomito/audiofakedetectorpro

records.name: PalinDragon
records.tagline: The daily word game where every solution is a palindrome
records.description: PalinDragon is a daily word game for Wordle fans who like a twist: every solution is a palindrome — a sentence that reads the same forwards and backwards. Make guesses, read the clues, and avoid getting stuck by trading guesses for reveals about the puzzle including oblique hints, and the puzzle's spacing and punctuation. One tap and share your run as a share grid image.

records.name: Universum
records.tagline: Open source N-body & CFD simulator for science and art
records.description: This interactive simulation visualizes how incredibly complex structures emerge from simple local interactions between millions of identical particles. Using only Newtonian attraction, short-range elastic repulsion, … Universum Space Simulator Read More »

records.name: Smart Server Finder
records.tagline: Find the Best Dedicated Server For You
records.description: Use iDatam's Smart Server Finder to paste your exact hosting requirements. Our automated engine instantly finds the perfect dedicated server match based on CPU, RAM, Storage, and Port speed.

records.name: Tip Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate tips instantly — split bills, any percentage, free
records.description: Calculate the perfect tip instantly. Split bills, choose tip percentage, and see totals per person – free tip calculator for restaurants, hotels, salons & more.

records.name: 20Clicks

records.description: 20Clicks is a full-service best digital marketing agency in Indore offering SEO, PPC, social media, web design, and branding services.
